snippet.title: Town to City - Animals Update Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
The Animals Update has arrived for Town to City! Give your citizens pets, decorate your town in new ways, and step right into the action with the brand new First Person View feature.

This update also introduces three new buildings to expand your growing community:
• Dress Maker – bring fashion to your citizens
• Patisserie – satisfy every sweet tooth
• Animal Shelter – care for your town’s newest furry friends

Build, decorate, and explore your world like never before in Town to City. Available now on Steam.
